items.item_text: Active RN license with the California Board of Registered Nursing.
Certified Asthma Educator.
BLS from the American Red Cross or American Heart Association.

The ideal candidate will have strong clinical experience in diabetes care, preferably in a pediatric setting. We are seeking a highly competent and proactive nursing professional with strong clinical judgment, excellent collaboration skills, flexibility, and the ability to take initiative in a fast-paced clinical environment.
2+ years of prior clinical nursing experience.

The RN Coordinator will support our Pediatric Pulmonary and Cystic Fibrosis clinics in Westwood and Santa Monica. You will provide direct nursing support to patients with cystic fibrosis and lung conditions in the outpatient setting. Primary duties include, but are not limited to:
Provide case coordination, including nursing services, patient teaching, coordination of medical authorization and referrals and follow-up nursing care
Assessing patient’s regimen of care and streamline diagnostic and therapeutic treatment plans
Discharge planning and outpatient care coordination
Cystic Fibrosis Program Coordinator; coordinate multidisciplinary patient care and serve as central resource for patients and families
Provide care plan oversight and participate in parent and patient education
Nurse coordinator for assigned California Children’s Services (CCS) Team Center Care clinics
The position requires flexibility to travel between multiple clinics as needed.
This position is expected to travel to multiple UCLA Health locations as needed.
CCS paneled in Pediatrics/Pediatric Pulmonology (will be expected to apply for paneling upon hire).
Ability to complete a Nursing physical assessment
Familiarity with the CCS and Medi-Cal programs.
Skill in developing a plan of care including setting goals, monitoring and documenting progress
Working knowledge of Pediatric pulmonary and cystic fibrosis centered care.
Ability to implement interventions that are pertinent to goals established in the plan of care
Bilingual oral and written communication skills (English/Spanish).
Ability to evaluate the effectiveness of interventions toward the attainment of established goals and to recognize the need to reassess or reset goal parameters
Ability to delegate tasks in a management style that is consistent with promoting leadership and teamwork
Knowledge base to provide education to patients, families, and other staff regarding clinical and patient care issues
Ability to travel within the Health System.
